# omadafusion_port_profile (Data Source)

Look up a switch port profile by name, including the built-in `All` and `Disable` profiles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_port_profile" "all" {
  name = "All"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Profile name.

### Optional

- `site` (String) Site name or ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Profile ID.
- `native_network_id` (String) Untagged network ID.
- `tagged_network_ids` (List of String) Tagged network IDs.
